title: CYBRIK org aggregate roll-up result v1 (D-8)
description: A DE-IDENTIFIED subtree roll-up result (ADR-0007 D-8; 02 §2.2; OD-2; FC-4). This is the payload an ancestor may see across a tier: counts/metrics only, NEVER raw records. It carries NO objectRef and no raw resource pattern — additionalProperties:false at every level means there is nowhere for a raw record, case id, or drill-down handle to live (a 'raw aggregate' is structurally impossible). Every reported cell is either SUPPRESSED (below the small-cell floor) or carries a count that MUST be >= the small_cell_floor (const 5, OD-2): a cell counting fewer than 5 underlying subjects is a re-identification risk and cannot be expressed unsuppressed. small_cell_floor const 5 pins the OD-2 floor; no differential privacy is adopted here. $id uses the RFC 2606 .example documentation domain. Status: ACCEPTED FOR IMPLEMENTATION (v0.1.0; not stable v1/GA). Accepted at Gate W2-G (Codex under Founder delegation, 2026-07-24).

request_ref.description: The request_id of the aggregate request this result answers (traceability).

tenant_id.description: The tenant this roll-up was computed in. MUST equal the request's / grant's tenant (OD-1).

target_node.description: The subtree root this roll-up covers.

small_cell_floor.description: Const 5 (OD-2): every unsuppressed cell count is >= this floor. A result declaring a smaller floor is not expressible.

dimensions.description: The metric dimensions rolled up, in order. Cell buckets are keyed by these dimension names. No raw identifiers.

cells.description: The de-identified cells. Each cell is EITHER suppressed OR reports a count >= small_cell_floor. No cell carries a raw record, objectRef, or drill-down handle.

items.description: A single de-identified aggregate cell. Exactly one of {count, suppressed} is present (oneOf). A counted cell has count >= 5 (the small-cell floor); a small cell is reported only as suppressed=true, never with its true sub-5 count.

bucket.description: The dimension coordinate of this cell: a map of dimension name -> de-identified category value (e.g. {"severity":"critical","category":"phishing"}). Values are coarsened category labels, never raw record identifiers.

count.description: Underlying subject count for this cell. minimum 5 = the small-cell floor (OD-2): a count below 5 is a re-identification risk and MUST instead be reported as a suppressed cell. Not present when suppressed=true.

suppressed.description: Const true: this cell fell below the small-cell floor and its count is withheld (its true count is NOT carried). Not present alongside count.
